name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Atlas Overdrive — Progress Intelligence & Immersive Tree
features: Added source-aware rank progress states, color legend, full/partial/unallocated highlighting, and reported upstream-link review markers throughout Talent Forge trees.
Introduced an optional full-screen Talent Atlas workspace on supported desktops with an accessible in-page fallback.
Mouse wheel inside an active tree now adjusts the existing Talent Atlas zoom. Drag panning, minimap, +/−, FIT, RESET and regular scrolling outside the tree remain available.
Progress indicators reflect planned points and Blizzard-returned data, not item rarity, acquisition difficulty or validated in-game prerequisites.
Preserved talent node IDs, original returned layout positions, rank/choice controls, saved builds, local media, account functions and the v6.1 visual identity.
